definitions.event_rule: An annotated segment is detected only when a new alert episode STARTS inside it. An already active pre-onset alarm does not detect the segment. False episode onset is outside every annotation. No point adjustment.
definitions.episode_rule: Consecutive above-threshold samples; no merging, smoothing, cooldown or persistence requirement. Reset at gaps.
definitions.gap_rule: Reset when timestamp interval >3 times per-recording median cadence; gaps excluded from observed exposure.
definitions.exposure_rule: Left-endpoint intervals between observed samples, excluding gaps and unscored warm-up; terminal sample contributes0 seconds.

selection_protocol: legacy_overlap_v1 retained solely to reproduce the original model selection; final metrics and API events use onset_v2.

legacy_report.note: Superseded overlap-based event metrics; retained for transparent correction history.

operating_point_verdict: Failed practical alert-burden check: the learned model stays in alert for almost all observed time. Event recall alone is misleading.
reporting_revision: Version2 corrects event matching to episode onsets and retains normal-alert exposure, point precision and group slices. Model, thresholds, selection and split are unchanged.
